Choose your package and Valampuri handles the rest.</p></div></div><div style="width:100%"><div class="trust-band trust-band--bare trust-band--hero" data-astro-cid-qlv4pxuf><ul class="trust-band__list" aria-label="Resort highlights" data-astro-cid-qlv4pxuf><li data-astro-cid-qlv4pxuf>No Deposit Required</li><li data-astro-cid-qlv4pxuf>600+ Verified Reviews</li><li data-astro-cid-qlv4pxuf>IKO-Certified School</li><li data-astro-cid-qlv4pxuf>Half &amp; Full Board Available</li><li data-astro-cid-qlv4pxuf>Free Boat Transfers</li><li data-astro-cid-qlv4pxuf>Family-Run Since 2016</li></ul></div></div></section><section class="quick-answer-wrap"><div class="quick-answer"><p class="quick-answer__label"><svg></svg> Quick Answer</p><p class="quick-answer__text"><strong>Kitesurfing holiday packages at Valampuri Resort in Kalpitiya start from €245 per person</strong> (Learn Together Escape: 3 nights, 6h group lessons, half board, 2 sharing). Solo packages with 9 hours of private IKO-certified instruction start at €470 per person. All packages include accommodation, breakfast and dinner, Duotone equipment, boat transfers to the kite area, walkie-talkie coaching, and rescue boat cover. Room-only stays start at €18 per person per night. Private <a href='/kitesurfing-lessons/'>kitesurfing lessons</a> without a package cost from €50 per hour.</p><div class="quick-answer__cta"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="https://wa.me/94776314144?text=Hi%20Valampuri%2C%20I%27d%20like%20to%20ask%20about%20kitesurfing%20packages%20and%20pricing.%20Dates%3A%20__" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Ask About Packages</a></div></div></section><div class="kite-nav-strip"><a href="#kite-packages">Packages</a><a href="#package-comparison">Compare packages</a><a href="#kite-lesson-prices">Lesson prices</a><a href="#kite-rental-prices">Rentals</a><a href="#price-guide">Price guide</a><a href="#why-book-direct">Why book direct</a><a href="#package-faq">FAQ</a></div><section class="section compact-section" style="padding-top:20px;padding-bottom:20px"> <p class="center">Compare the full trip before you book: <a class="text-link" href="/kitesurfing-lessons/">beginner kitesurfing lessons in Kalpitiya</a>, <a class="text-link" href="/private-kitesurf-lessons/">private kitesurf lessons</a>, the <a class="text-link" href="/beginner-kitesurf-course/">beginner kitesurf course</a>, <a class="text-link" href="/rates-offers/#kite-packages">kite surf and stay packages</a>, <a class="text-link" href="/stay/">kitesurfing accommodation in Kalpitiya</a>, <a class="text-link" href="/kite-rentals/">kite rentals for independent riders</a>, and the <a class="text-link" href="/kitesurfing-season-sri-lanka/">Kalpitiya season guide</a>.</p> </section> <section class="section section-soft" id="kite-packages"> <div class="section-heading"> <p class="eyebrow">Kitesurfing package Kalpitiya</p> <h2>Kite surf and stay packages with lessons, rooms, food, and boat support</h2> <p>The kite + stay package is where most guests start. It's also where most of them stop looking at other options. One booking covers your room, lessons or rental, meals, boat transfers, and rescue: no separate negotiations with a kite school across town. Not sure which season to book? Check our <a href="/kitesurfing-season-sri-lanka/">kite season guide</a> first. And if you're unsure whether you need the 6-hour or 9-hour course, see <a href="/how-long-to-learn-kitesurfing/">how many hours it takes to learn</a>.</p><!-- Anchoring: competitor price context You arrive, drop your bags, and your whole week is already sorted. Wind is up: you're on the water. Wind is light: pool, food, rest. Your partner doesn't kite: dolphins in the morning, Wilpattu in the afternoon. Nobody has to plan anything or argue about where to eat.</p> <p>That's what one base does. Packages at Valampuri are built so you stop managing your holiday and start living it.</p> </div> <div class="info-card"> <h3>Usually included</h3> <ul class="list-check"> <li>Accommodation close to the lagoon</li> <li>Breakfast and dinner</li> <li>Lessons or rental support</li> <li>Boat transfer or local access support</li> <li>Rescue cover where needed</li> </ul> </div> </div> </section> <section class="section section-soft"> <div class="two-col"> <div> <p class="eyebrow">Rooms + packages</p> <h2>Compare packages, rooms, and lesson prices on one page</h2> <p>This page brings together room choices, lesson prices, rental rates, and ready-made offers so you can compare the complete stay in one place. Most guests find Valampuri through reviews written by people who stayed here: they arrived, spent a week, left knowing how to kite, and wrote about it.</p> <p>The school is family-run. The instructors are the same people who have breakfast nearby. Your name gets remembered by the second day. That's just what happens when a resort is small by design and isn't trying to process 200 guests at once.</p> </div> <div class="info-card"> <h3>Why guests choose Valampuri</h3> <ul class="list-check"> <li>600+ verified reviews and repeat riders</li> <li>IKO-certified school with beginner to Level 3 progression</li> <li>Lagoon-side rooms, pool, restaurant, and family options</li> <li>Direct booking without marketplace fees</li> <li>Lessons, rental, rooms, and trips from one place</li> </ul> </div> </div> </section> <section class="section section-soft" id="price-guide"> <div class="two-col"> <div> <p class="eyebrow">Price guide</p> <h2>How much does a kitesurfing holiday in Sri Lanka cost?</h2> <p>A kitesurfing holiday at Valampuri costs from €245 per person (3 nights, group lessons, half board, two sharing) up to €590 per person (5 nights, private lessons, half board); lessons alone start at €50 per hour and room-only stays at €18 per person per night. The main cost depends on whether you need lessons, rental, accommodation, half board, and boat support. Some travellers want only lessons, while others want a full kitesurfing camp Sri Lanka style package with room, meals, and daily riding support from one base.</p> <p>Valampuri keeps those choices clear by showing lesson prices, rental rates, rooms, and full package options on the same page so you can compare the full cost of a Kalpitiya kitesurfing trip more easily.</p> </div> <div class="info-card"> <h3>Most common price questions</h3> <ul class="list-check"> <li>Lessons only versus lesson-and-stay package</li> <li>Private coaching versus semi-private sessions</li> <li>Rental for independent riders</li> <li>Room type and meal plan</li> <li>Boat support and transfer needs</li> </ul> </div> </div> </section> <section class="section"> <div class="two-col"> <div> <p class="eyebrow">Package types</p> <h2>What types of kitesurfing packages can you book?</h2> <p>Valampuri offers six package types: two solo lesson packages, a couples package, a longer five-night lesson package, a rental package for independent riders, and a ten-night extended stay. Not every guest wants the same kind of package. Some want a short discover-style break with a few lesson hours and an easy room setup. Others want a longer learn package with more coaching, or a relaxed enjoy package built around riding, food, and rest days.</p> <p>That is why Valampuri offers several package styles for solo riders, couples, and progression-focused guests instead of one fixed kitesurfing holiday package. You can start with the closest match and then adjust nights, room type, and lesson hours around your dates.</p> </div> <div class="info-card"> <h3>Most common package goals</h3> <ul class="list-check"> <li>Learn-to-kite holiday with accommodation</li> <li>Lessons and stay in Kalpitiya from one base</li> <li>Progression package with more hours on the water</li> <li>Couples package with one shared room</li> <li>Independent rider stay with rental support</li> </ul> </div> </div> </section> <section class="section faq-section" id="package-faq"> <div class="section-heading"><p class="eyebrow">Packages FAQ</p><h2>Before you book a package</h2></div> <div class="faq-list"> <details class="faq-item" open><summary>What happens if there's no wind during my course?</summary><p>Lessons are scheduled around the daily wind window. If conditions don't allow kiting on a given day, we reschedule your remaining hours within your stay wherever possible.</p></details> <details class="faq-item"><summary>Can I add extra nights to a package?</summary><p>Yes. Extra nights can be added to any package at the standard room rate: just let us know when you enquire.</p></details> <details class="faq-item"><summary>What if I don't finish all my lesson hours?</summary><p>Progression speed varies by rider. If you don't use all your booked hours during your stay, ask us about carrying them over or extending your course.</p></details> <details class="faq-item"><summary>Can I upgrade from group to private lessons?</summary><p>Yes, you can upgrade at any time during your stay, subject to instructor availability: see the lesson price table above for the difference in rate.</p></details> <details class="faq-item"><summary>Is the IKO certificate included in every package?</summary><p>IKO certification is included in all kitesurfing lesson packages. Rental-only and extended-stay packages without lessons do not include certification.</p></details> <details class="faq-item"><summary>How do I book a kite resort in Kalpitiya?</summary><p>Send us your dates, room type and lesson or rental preference via WhatsApp or the contact form. You'll get a confirmation within 24 hours with payment and transfer details. No third-party booking fees.</p></details> <details class="faq-item"><summary>Do you offer family kite holidays in Kalpitiya?</summary><p>Yes. The Family Eco Chalet and Garden Family Suite sleep up to 6, and the pool, garden and shallow lagoon side make Valampuri a practical Kalpitiya kite resort for families where one parent kites and the rest of the family stays close by.</p></details> <details class="faq-item"><summary>Is Valampuri a kitesurfing resort with pool?</summary><p>Yes. Valampuri is a lagoon-side kite resort with a full swimming pool, a garden, an on-site seafood restaurant and rooms from budget dorm to family suite, kitesurfing accommodation for every level and budget.</p></details> <details class="faq-item"><summary>What does the kite surf and stay package in Kalpitiya include?</summary><p>Every kite surf and stay package includes accommodation, half board (breakfast and dinner), IKO certified lessons or rental gear, boat transfer to the teaching area, walkie-talkie coaching for lesson guests, and rescue boat cover.</p></details> <details class="faq-item"><summary>Which Kalpitiya kitesurfing package is best for beginners?</summary><p>Most beginners choose a lesson package with 6 to 9 hours of coaching, accommodation, half board, and boat support included. If you are travelling alone, start with the Wind Rider Dorm Escape. If you are travelling as a couple, the Learn Together Escape is usually the simplest option.</p></details><details class="faq-item"><summary>What is the average cost of a kitesurfing holiday in Kalpitiya?</summary><p>A full beginner kite holiday at Valampuri starts at €245 per person (Learn Together Escape: 3 nights, 6h group lessons, half board, 2 sharing) and goes up to €590 per person (Independent Rider Bungalow Week: 5 nights AC bungalow, 6h private lessons, half board). Room-only stays start at €18 per person per night.</p></details><details class="faq-item"><summary>Should I book accommodation and lessons together?</summary><p>Yes. Combined packages save money and simplify logistics. The Wind Rider Dorm Escape (€470 pp) bundles 3 nights, 9h private lessons, half board, boat transfers, and rescue; booking these separately would cost more.</p></details><details class="faq-item"><summary>Which package offers the best value?</summary><p>The Learn Together Escape (€245 pp, 2 sharing) offers the lowest per-person cost for a beginner kite holiday. The Wind Rider Dorm Escape (€470 pp) is the best value for solo travellers wanting the full 9-hour private course.</p></details><details class="faq-item"><summary>Do you offer couple packages?</summary><p>Yes. The Learn Together Escape (€245 pp) is designed for two people sharing accommodation and group lessons. Couples can also book the Open-Air Cabana (€30 pp, tagged "Best for Couples") with individual or shared kite lessons.</p></details><details class="faq-item"><summary>Is breakfast included?</summary><p>Yes. All room rates at Valampuri include breakfast. Half board (adding dinner) comes with selected rooms and all kite packages, and any room can upgrade. Full board (adding lunch) is an extra €16 per person per day.</p></details></div> </section> <section class="section section-soft" id="kite-surf-and-stay"> <div class="two-col"> <div> <p class="eyebrow">Kite surf and stay</p> <h2>Kite surf and stay in Kalpitiya at a single lagoon-side base</h2> <p>Valampuri bundles kitesurfing accommodation, IKO certified lessons or rental, and full board into one direct booking.
